disclaimer: These activities are for reflection and learning. They are not medical advice, diagnostic tools, or psychological therapy.

activities.title: Breathing Guide
activities.tagline: Rhythmic autonomic regulation via targeted respiratory pacing
activities.howToUse: Select a rhythm pattern (Box 4-4-4-4, 4-7-8 for sleep, or Coherent 5-5 for heart rate variability). Inhale as the circle expands, hold comfortably, and exhale smoothly as it contracts.
activities.whatItMeasures: Activates the parasympathetic vagal brake, reducing sympathetic nervous arousal, lowering salivary cortisol, and modulating prefrontal heart-rate variability (HRV).

activities.title: Memory Match
activities.howToUse: Flip cards two at a time to locate matching abstract symbols. Choose between 6, 12, or 16 card layouts. Try to minimise total turns and latency.
activities.whatItMeasures: Tests the visuospatial sketchpad component of Baddeley's working memory model and executive control of attentional shifting without verbal rehearsal cues.

activities.title: Stroop Test
activities.howToUse: A color word appears (e.g. 'RED' written in green ink). Click the button matching the physical INK COLOR, completely ignoring the written word. Complete 10 fast rounds.
activities.whatItMeasures: Quantifies the 'Stroop Effect' latency delta between congruent and incongruent stimulus processing in the anterior cingulate cortex and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex.

activities.title: Reaction Timer
activities.howToUse: Wait patiently while the screen is calm terracotta. The moment it bursts into bright sage, click or tap anywhere as rapidly as possible. Averages your last 5 attempts.
activities.whatItMeasures: Captures raw afferent optical sensory transmission through the lateral geniculate nucleus to motor cortex efferent finger depression latency (typical human baseline 190 — 260ms).

activities.title: Gratitude & Thought Journal
activities.tagline: Affective reframing & cognitive savoring in private storage
activities.howToUse: Record brief daily observations, micro-victories, or reflections using daily rotating prompts. Entries are stored only in your local browser storage and can be exported as a text file.
activities.whatItMeasures: Operationalizes Fredrickson's Broaden-and-Build theory of positive affect by counteracting biological evolutionary negativity bias through conscious gratitude attribution.

activities.title: Visual Illusion Gallery
activities.tagline: Perceptual hypothesis testing & top-down visual priors
activities.howToUse: Explore classical visual illusions: Müller-Lyer, Ebbinghaus circles, Kanizsa illusory contours, and the Ponzo perspective track. Toggle 'Reveal guides' to verify optical parity.
activities.whatItMeasures: Demonstrates Helmholtz's unconscious inference: the visual cortex projects top-down depth and perspective priors onto 2D retina projections rather than faithfully relaying raw photons.

activities.title: Mood Reflection (Affect Labelling)
activities.tagline: Linguistic categorization of current emotional states
activities.howToUse: Select the descriptor that closest describes your current feeling state from eight curated emotional axes. Receive an immediate psychological reflection prompt without any diagnostic scoring.
activities.whatItMeasures: Draws on Matthew Lieberman's neuroimaging research showing that affect labelling (putting feelings into words) dampens amygdala activation via the right ventrolateral prefrontal cortex.
